tasks.description: Create a product catalog that allows merchants to create, edit, and delete products. Each product should have a name, description, one or more images, a price, a SKU, and a category.
acceptance_criteria: Given a merchant account, when creating a new product, then the product is added to the catalog.
Given a merchant account, when editing a product, then the product details are updated in the catalog.
Given a merchant account, when deleting a product, then the product is removed from the catalog.

tasks.description: Create a category system that allows products to be organized and browsable by customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when assigning a category, then the product is listed under that category.
Given a category, when viewing the category page, then all products in that category are displayed.

tasks.description: Create a search function that allows customers to search for products by keyword.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when searching for products, then relevant products are displayed in the search results.
Given a search query, when filtering search results by category, then only products in that category are displayed.

tasks.description: Create filtering and sorting options for search results and category pages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when filtering by price range, then only products within that price range are displayed.
Given a search query, when sorting by price, then products are displayed in the correct order.

tasks.description: Create a shopping cart that allows customers to add and remove products.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when adding to cart, then the product is added to the cart.
Given a product in the cart, when removing from cart, then the product is removed from the cart.

tasks.description: Create a system that persists the shopping cart across sessions for logged-in users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in user, when adding a product to the cart, then the cart is persisted across sessions.

tasks.description: Create a checkout process that collects shipping and billing addresses and requires authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cart with products, when proceeding to checkout, then the checkout process is initiated.
Given a checkout process, when completing the checkout, then the order is created and the cart is cleared.

tasks.description: Create a system that calculates the shipping cost based on the destination address and order weight.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order, when calculating shipping cost, then the shipping cost is calculated correctly.

tasks.description: Create a payment processing system that uses Stripe to charge the customer.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order, when processing payment, then the payment is processed correctly.
Given a payment failure, when retrying payment, then the customer is prompted to retry payment.

tasks.description: Create an order management system that allows customers to view their order history and merchants to view and update order status.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer, when viewing order history, then the customer's orders are displayed.
Given a merchant, when viewing orders, then all orders are displayed.

tasks.description: Create an inventory tracking system that decrements stock quantity when an order is placed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when placing an order, then the stock quantity is decremented correctly.

tasks.description: Create a system that sends email receipts to customers after an order is successfully paid.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order, when sending email receipt, then the email receipt is sent correctly.

tasks.description: Create a review and rating system that allows customers to leave reviews and ratings for products.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when leaving a review, then the review is displayed on the product page.
Given a product, when viewing reviews, then all reviews are displayed.

tasks.description: Create a wishlist system that allows customers to add and remove products from their wishlist.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when adding to wishlist, then the product is added to the wishlist.
Given a product in the wishlist, when removing from wishlist, then the product is removed from the wishlist.

tasks.description: Create an admin panel that allows merchants to manage their store, including product management, category management, order management, and inventory visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a merchant, when accessing the admin panel, then the merchant can manage their store.
Given a merchant, when viewing orders, then all orders are displayed.

tasks.description: Create an authentication system that allows customers and merchants to log in and access their accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer, when logging in, then the customer is authenticated correctly.
Given a merchant, when logging in, then the merchant is authenticated correctly.

tasks.description: Create an authorization system that restricts access to certain features based on user role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer, when accessing a restricted feature, then the customer is denied access.
Given a merchant, when accessing a restricted feature, then the merchant is granted access.

tasks.description: Create a database schema that supports the e-commerce platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given a database, when creating the schema, then the schema is created correctly.

tasks.description: Create API endpoints that support the e-commerce platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API endpoint, when making a request, then the request is handled correctly.
Given an API endpoint, when receiving a response, then the response is correct.

tasks.description: Create an error handling system that handles errors and exceptions in the e-commerce platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error, when handling the error, then the error is handled correctly.

tasks.description: Create a logging system that logs important events in the e-commerce platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event, when logging the event, then the event is logged correctly.
